## About
Roaldo's Auto Service is a small auto repair shop in Northeast Minneapolis, family owned and operated. We do our best to keep your vehicle going and going, and we try to give you the best deals in town without harming your budget.
We work on repairs at your request and only encourage the ones that are needed. If something can wait, or isn't worth fixing, we'll point that out too.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 74 reviews on Google. One reviewer put it simply: "Very happy to have this place in my neighborhood."

## Services
- Oil Change: Regular oil changes to keep your engine running right.
- Tires / Mounting & Wheel Balance: Tire mounting and wheel balancing.
- Electrical / Basic repairs: Electrical problems and basic repairs.
- Transmission: We renew the transmission filter and fluid.
- Doors Hardware & Windows Regulators: Door hardware and window regulator repairs.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Mon - Fri: 8 AM - 5 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 2319 1/2 Jackson St NE, Minneapolis, MN 55418.

Q: Will you push repairs I don't need?
A: No. We work on repairs at your request, only encourage the ones that are needed, and point out things that can wait or aren't worth fixing.

## What customers say

Roaldo and the team there are always so good at communicating my options, and how much it’ll cost. This place is honest, affordable, no frills, and friendly! They take pride in their work and will make sure your car leaves their shop in great shape and usually within a few hours of bringing it in." (Julia Ploof, 5/5)
